title: Gantt Studio
subtitle: Plan visually. Edit as Mermaid.
description: Drag a schedule into place, draw dependencies and see the critical path. Switch to Mermaid text without losing the plan. Everything stays in your browser.
longDescription: A browser-only Gantt editor with visual scheduling and two-way Mermaid editing. Tasks, dependencies, baselines and working-day calendars live in localStorage. It needs no account or backend and exports PNG, Excel and JSON.
features: Drag tasks, resize durations and draw dependencies
Two-way Mermaid editing with metadata preserved
Automatic scheduling, critical path and baselines
Keyboard controls and four interface languages
